question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing benchwarmer, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing left back, and Gertrude is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) striker
(C) right midfielder
(D) benchwarmer
(E) center midfielder
(F) left back
(G) sweeper
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: right back | striker | right midfielder | benchwarmer | center midfielder | left back | sweeper
After Claire–Gertrude: right back | striker | sweeper | benchwarmer | center midfielder | left back | right midfielder
After Bob–Claire: right back | sweeper | striker | benchwarmer | center midfielder | left back | right midfielder
After Bob–Fred: right back | left back | striker | benchwarmer | center midfielder | sweeper | right midfielder
After Dave–Eve: right back | left back | striker | center midfielder | benchwarmer | sweeper | right midfielder
After Eve–Bob: right back | benchwarmer | striker | center midfielder | left back | sweeper | right midfielder
After Dave–Bob: right back | center midfielder | striker | benchwarmer | left back | sweeper | right midfielder
After Alice–Claire: striker | center midfielder | right back | benchwarmer | left back | sweeper | right midfielder
Fred is playing sweeper, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
